_doc: Every gameplay/physics tuning value of the PoC. Units: design pixels (1080x1920), seconds, px/s, px/s^2. Water volumes are 2D areas in px^2.

tiers._doc: Size curve shared by every level: tier t covers base_area * ratio^(t-1) px^2 (1.45 => tier 9 ~19x tier 1). resistance[t-1] = seconds at full drain pressure to squeeze a plug of that tier through.

merge._triple_doc: TRIPLE MERGE: a pair waits triple_window s before merging; a third matching object that touches either (or rests within triple_pad px) joins and the three become TWO next-tier objects.

chain._doc: Merges less than `window` s apart build a chain; multiplier = min(max_mult, 1 + step*(chain-1)) on merge points AND flush-meter gain (banked cascades).

meter._doc: Flush is an earned ability: merges fill the meter (per_merge + tier_bonus*(new_tier-2), x chain multiplier, + triple_bonus); a full meter = +1 flush charge.

royal._doc: ROYAL FLUSH: creating the last tier of a level. Slow-mo for `delay` s, then a long vortex while every object is released into the drain one by one (`stagger` s, nearest first) and scored x multiplier. `timeout` s later stragglers are scored and removed and the level is complete.

flush._vortex_doc: Side view of a whirlpool around the vertical drain axis: suction pulls DOWN (strongest on the axis), objects are drawn TOWARD the axis, the swirl shows as a sideways slosh + spin. All scaled by 1/(1 + distance_to_drain/falloff).
